summary: Updates the dmaic-analyze skill to prevent schema compliance failures. The agent failed verification by using ad-hoc inline Python instead of the provided script, resulting in incorrect JSON key names (primary_window vs primary_analysis_window), missing record_count inside filter objects, and omitted statistical fields (f_statistic, r_squared, n_observations, std_dev). Strengthens guidance to use the bundled script and adds explicit schema validation checkpoints.
